unsupported_claims.quote: Breadcrumbs show errors precede 401 responses (e.g., "preceded by 401 responses from /api/settlements/CustomerOrder/Search").

The parenthetical '(41+39 users)' equals 80, not 144; the 144 is actually 41+39+33+31, so the parenthetical is a mathematical error that misrepresents which numbers were summed.
